in_sanskrit.name: सोमेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord of the Moon, the radiant one. The name Somesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Ish' meaning Lord.

in_hindi.name: सोमेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: Soma+kīyā, meaning one who is related to or associated with the moon.

in_tamil.name: சோமேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Cōmam ilirundha śīṣam, meaning the one who has the moon or is related to the moon.

in_telugu.name: శోమేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Śōmadeśapēṭu, meaning the one who is the lord of the moon.

in_marathi.name: Somesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Somesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God who controls the Moon and bestows knowledge

in_bengali.name: Somesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Moon
in_bengali.long_meaning: Somesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। God who controls the Moon and bestows knowledge
